RPE vs Percentage Training: A Systematic Review

Abstract: We reviewed 12 randomized trials comparing autoregulated (RPE-based) and percentage-based resistance training programs in trained populations. Effect sizes for strength gains were similar across methods when volume was equated.

Conclusion: Both approaches are viable for strength development. Athletes may choose based on lifestyle factors, coaching preferences, and comfort with self-assessed effort.
